role: One post-open Case 19 mechanism audit of a geometry-local solver-native preconditioner that is physically different from the closed fixed-depth, global low-rank tail, diagonal-Jacobi, Sobolev and global quadratic geometry-weight routes.
scientific_question: Can an exact reported-geometry three-axis additive line-block Schwarz preconditioner remove the common cold-start interior-gradient stagnation while the unchanged causal FIFO16 warm plus PCGLS K14 preserves every absolute and line-PCGLS-K16-matched gate at fewer exact A/A^T calls?
physical_hypothesis: The sealed Case 19 blocker is shared by every old arm at frame zero and is therefore not an arm-selection or observation-residual-selection defect. If missing within-line normal-operator couplings cause that stagnation, exact local line blocks of A^T A should improve the K16 reference, while causal FIFO16 recycling should retain the reference at K14 and zero/BP controls should remain incomplete.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each frozen rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_permutation_requirement: Reversing the labeled source roster and canonicalizing it must reproduce identical canonical IDs, observations, line blocks, fields, residuals, calls, metrics and decisions within the frozen numeric bounds.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v244.2 full-grid rectilinear verification, source-to-zyx axis map, float64 trilinear interpolation, one-voxel support, mean gauge and 33 noncontiguous snapshots without alteration.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the frozen synthetic observations and scores the four veto metrics only. It does not enter geometry blocks, preconditioning, initialization, cache updates, depth, control selection, fallback or stopping.

unique_preconditioner.name: exact_reported_geometry_three_axis_additive_line_schwarz_relative_floor_1e-6
unique_preconditioner.normal_operator: Use the exact reported-geometry straight-ray forward A and its exact adjoint.

partitions.z_lines: All 16x16 coordinate lines of length 32 at fixed (y,x).
partitions.y_lines: All 32x16 coordinate lines of length 16 at fixed (z,x).
partitions.x_lines: All 32x16 coordinate lines of length 16 at fixed (z,y).

unique_preconditioner.block_definition: For every line R_l, form B_l = R_l (A^T A) R_l^T by summing exact per-view, per-component operator row outer products. No observation or truth enters B_l.
unique_preconditioner.eigendecomposition: Use float64 symmetric eigh independently for every line block.
unique_preconditioner.absolute_floor: 1e-6 times the maximum raw eigenvalue over every z/y/x line block in that rig; only float64 tiny may replace an underflowed floor.
unique_preconditioner.scale: Multiply each floored line inverse by the median strictly positive entry of diag(A^T A), derived identically from the z-line block diagonals.
unique_preconditioner.application: Apply all line inverses to the matching restriction of the current normal residual, prolong by zero insertion, sum the three axis results and divide by exactly 3.
unique_preconditioner.boundary: The frozen one-voxel support remains part of A. Unsupported and rank-deficient block eigenmodes receive the same global absolute floor; no mask-dependent block deletion is allowed.
unique_preconditioner.tie_break: No discrete choice or tie exists; axis order is z,y,x and only roundoff from fixed float64 accumulation/eigh is permitted.
unique_preconditioner.forbidden_search: No axis subset, line length, overlapping window, block grouping, floor, scale, axis weight, damping, depth, cache rank, regularizer, metric, threshold or candidate search is allowed after freeze.

solver_and_arms.common_frame_zero: For every rig and every new line-Schwarz arm, run zero-start line-Schwarz PCGLS K16 on frame zero, score that same anchor for all new arms and initialize FIFO16 from its sixteen paired field/projected directions.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_geometry_line_schwarz_pcgls_k14
unique_primary.later_frame_rule: Project the current observation onto the pre-update FIFO16 projected basis, lift with the paired field basis, run the unchanged PCGLS recurrence for K14 using the fixed line-Schwarz map, then update FIFO with the first current-frame direction using the unchanged v237 acceptance and FIFO rule.

sealed_same_cost_mechanism_control.name: canonical_camera_dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_actual_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
sealed_same_cost_mechanism_control.source: sealed v244.2 formal and independent arrays
sealed_same_cost_mechanism_control.known_boundary: All old arms share the same failed diagonal-PCGLS-K16 frame-zero field; this control is reported but not used as a new line-reference-matched arm.

solver_and_arms.recurrence: Standard fixed-SPD PCGLS recurrence. The only change from v244 is replacing elementwise geometry-Jacobi application by the frozen additive line-Schwarz application.

accuracy_contract.control_dominance: Either new equal-or-cheaper control passing all absolute and line-K16-matched cell and complete-rig gates blocks a warm-specific claim.

formal_method: Rebuild all 33 truths and 13 canonical nine-camera operators from sealed raw inputs; build exact line blocks with vectorized per-component row contractions; run and physically replay all four new arms; seal fields, residuals, observations, calls, preconditioner audit and predictions before truth scoring.
independent_method: A separate validator must not import the v247 formal numerical core. It must rebuild each local line Gram with explicit line extraction and matrix.T@matrix, independently eigensolve/apply blocks, rerun all recurrences/caches/physical replay/metrics/tails/calls/permutation and compare formal arrays only after its own results are fixed.
decision_order: Any source, parent, shape, finite, SPD, symmetry, stationarity, permutation, call-ledger, physical-replay, output-exclusivity, seal or formal-independent mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_GEOMETRY_LINE_SCHWARZ_V247.
If the unique line-Schwarz K16 reference fails any absolute cell or complete-rig gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_GEOMETRY_LINE_SCHWARZ_REFERENCE_V247 and close this reference mechanism.
If the reference passes but the unique warm K14 primary fails any absolute or reference-matched gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_GEOMETRY_LINE_SCHWARZ_WARM_V247 and close this warm mechanism.
If reference and primary pass but either equal-or-cheaper new control also passes, conclude PASS_CASE19_LINE_SCHWARZ_HEADROOM_BUT_WARM_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V247.
Only if reference and primary pass, both new controls fail and independent validation passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_GEOMETRY_LINE_SCHWARZ_WARM_SPECIFIC_HEADROOM_V247.
failure_action: Close the exact three-axis additive coordinate-line Schwarz mechanism without changing axis subsets, blocks, floor, scale, depth, cache or thresholds. Do not use a larger predictor or GPU to rescue it.
